pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[ActionProcessor\] App with id: {GUID} to (?:install|uninstall) is in GRS\. The app will not be enforced\.
description: GRS (Global Retry Schedule) skip: the app failed recently and IME will not re-enforce it this check-in ('App with id: <guid> to install is in GRS. The app will not be enforced.', EnforcementActionProcessor / MixedEnforcementActionProcessor). THE canonical reason an app silently does nothing for up to 24h - previously invisible. Lives in AppActionProcessor.log, which the agent tails since the 2026-08-18 release; wording verified in IME 1.97 and 1.104.
